chunks: (Moses) said: "The Lord of the East and the West and all that lies between them, if you have sense."

key_terms.تَعْقِلُونَ: you use your intellect / if you have sense

ai.seo_question: Who spoke the words 'The Lord of the East and the West' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse (26:20) is part of the dialogue where Prophet Moses (AS) challenges Pharaoh's claim to divinity by affirming Allah as the Lord of the East and West. The phrase 'and what is between them' emphasizes God's comprehensive dominion over all spatial dimensions, while the concluding 'if you are to reason' serves as a rhetorical appeal to Pharaoh's intellect to recognize this universal sovereignty.
